rules.description: ReportFindings output: report every surviving finding
stock: with `{level, findings}`. `findings` is at most ${MAX_FINDINGS} entries ranked
unnerf: with `{level, findings}`. `findings` includes every surviving entry — at least
${MAX_FINDINGS} when that many qualify, and more when more do — ranked

rules.description: ReportFindings output: drop final findings cap
stock: `test-coverage` when one fits better) — plus `verdict` when a verify pass
produced one. If more than ${MAX_FINDINGS} survive, keep the ${MAX_FINDINGS} most severe. If
nothing survives verification, call it with an empty array. Do not also print
the findings as text, and do not create or publish an artifact of the review -
the tool call is the report.
unnerf: `test-coverage` when one fits better) — plus `verdict` when a verify pass
produced one. If more than ${MAX_FINDINGS} survive, report all of them —
${MAX_FINDINGS} is a floor, not a ceiling. If
nothing survives verification, call it with an empty array. Do not also print
the findings as text, and do not create or publish an artifact of the review -
the tool call is the report.
